Therefore, what was improved in large quantities into agricultural land in this region was saline-alkali land.

<image1>

1989年—2010年该区域大量哪类土地被改良成农业用地？

claims.source: The one that decreased most obviously in the same period and was most likely converted in large quantities into agricultural land is saline-alkali land.

claims.claim: What was improved in large quantities into agricultural land in this region was saline-alkali land.
claims.label: reasoning
claims.source: Therefore, what was improved in large quantities into agricultural land in this region was saline-alkali land.
